research_rationale: Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register machine text of Executive Order 12668 (54 FR 3979, PDF pages 9-10 of the 1989-01-27 issue; sha256 not repeated here), headed Executive Order 12668 of January 25, 1989, President’s Commission on Federal Ethics Law Reform, matching the census register row (1989-01-25). The OCR of the body is badly garbled in parts; I read the missing words against the American Presidency Project transcription held in the dossier (a mirror, used only to read the garbled sections, never quoted), which shows sections 1 through 5 as I describe them. Text and inventory: the machine inventory has four clauses and treats sections 2 through 4 as one scope because the headings of sections 3 and 4 are garbled; the four scopes together span the order from section 1 to section 5(b), so no operative text is outside them, and I confirm the inventory on that basis. Ending: Executive Order 12692 section 3(c) revokes Executive Order 12668, effective September 30, 1989 (section 5). The report deadline in section 2 and the report-relative termination in section 5(b) are not ends (owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on report deadlines). Original grade: Federal Register machine text.
savings_reason: Executive Order 12692 contains no wording that preserves the order establishing the President's Commission on Federal Ethics Law Reform: its section 1 continues other committees, its section 2 reassigns Federal Advisory Committee Act functions only for those other committees, and its section 3 revokes this order without exception. Reports or other work already done are completed acts; nothing continues the Commission.
earlier_end_check: Candidate earlier ends examined. (1) Section 5(b) ends the Commission 30 days after its report unless sooner extended; no held source dates the report, so no own-terms end is claimed (owner ruling of 2026-10-21). (2) The March 9, 1989 deadline is a deadline, not an end. (3) A search of the held corpus for the number 12668 found only Executive Order 12692 and the order's own texts; the OFR disposition-note machine search lists one hit. No instrument before 12692 revokes the order.
scope_check: All four clauses end by the same revocation. Section 3(c) of Executive Order 12692 revokes Executive Order 12668 as a whole with no exception.
independent_command_check: Section 4, which directs the Counsel to the President to give periodic reports on implementation after the Commission reports, is the one command that could be read to outlive the Commission. It has no end date of its own and belongs to this order, so Executive Order 12692 section 3(c), which revokes the order without exception, ends it with the rest; no held source preserves it. The other provisions serve only the Commission.

research_rationale: Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register text of Executive Order 13168 (65 FR 58217, PDF pages 1-2 of the 2000-09-27 issue; sha256 4fd3fdda...), headed Executive Order 13168 of September 22, 2000, President’s Commission on Improving Economic Opportunity in Communities Dependent on Tobacco Production While Protecting Public Health, matching the census register row (2000-09-22). Text and inventory: ten scopes cover sections 1 through 6 to the signature; I confirm the inventory. All clauses belong to one advisory commission. Ending: Executive Order 13225 section 3(d) revokes Executive Order 13168, effective September 30, 2001 (section 5), which is earlier than the outer limit of section 6 (September 22, 2002). The report deadlines in section 4 and the report-relative termination in section 6 are not ends (owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on report deadlines). Original grade: Federal Register machine text.
savings_reason: Executive Order 13225 contains no wording that preserves the order establishing the President's Commission on Improving Economic Opportunity in Communities Dependent on Tobacco Production While Protecting Public Health: its continuance sections concern other committees and its revocation section revokes this order without exception. Reports or other work already done are completed acts; nothing continues the body.
earlier_end_check: Candidate earlier ends examined. (1) Section 6 ends the Commission 30 days after its final report; no held source dates it, so no own-terms end is claimed (owner ruling of 2026-10-21). (2) The two-year outer limit, September 22, 2002, falls after the revocation. (3) A search of the held corpus for the number 13168 found only Executive Order 13225 and the order's own texts; the OFR disposition-note machine search lists one hit.
scope_check: All ten clauses end by the same revocation. Section 3(d) of Executive Order 13225 revokes Executive Order 13168 as a whole with no exception.
independent_command_check: The order has no command that outlives the Commission: the information, support and Federal Advisory Committee Act provisions serve only the Commission.
savings_check: Executive Order 13225 has no wording preserving the Commission or its work; sections 1 through 5 were read.
